worldcombat.skill.soak.summary: Pour a torrent of water over the chosen target and wash its whole type away into pure Water. Enemies or allies can be chosen; Flood only reaches the same side.
worldcombat.skill.soak.use.0: wash the target's type and STAB into Water
worldcombat.skill.soak.use.1: open Electric and Grass weaknesses while shutting down Fire and Ground STAB
worldcombat.skill.soak.use.2: give an ally a Water-resisting coat, or drench one ring of the same side at once
worldcombat.skill.soak.description.0: Wash all of the target's current types into pure Water for %1$s, restoring them when the water dries.
worldcombat.skill.soak.description.1: Pour range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s; range follows size and level, wind-up follows Speed, recovery follows Sp. Def.
worldcombat.skill.soak.description.2: Splash radius about %1$s blocks, wider on a wider body. The splash only bursts on a target that was actually re-typed.
worldcombat.skill.soak.flood.on: Flood: drench the target and the ring of the same side; the splash reaches %1$s blocks, each drench is shorter, and the cooldown is %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.soak.flood.off: Trickle: one target only, drench lasting %1$s, with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.soak.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
On = Flood: drench the target and the ring of the same side, but each drench is shorter and the cooldown longer; off = Trickle: one target, a longer drench and a shorter cooldown. Coverage trades against duration.
worldcombat.skill.soak.preference.ai.max: The companion only considers drenching a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases further.
worldcombat.skill.soak.preference.ai.lea: When on, it will leave its post to drench the target.
worldcombat.skill.soak.growth.0: From level %1$s, base cooldown is shortened by 0.5 s.
worldcombat.skill.soak.growth.1: From level %1$s, base cooldown is shortened by 1.1 s, replacing the previous growth reduction.
world_combat.move.soak.text.dry: The water dries; its type returns
world_combat.move.soak.text.fizzle: Already pure Water, nothing to drench
world_combat.move.soak.text.empty: Only water splashed out; no type to drench
worldcombat.skill.soak.description.3: A target that is already pure Water, has its type locked, or has no types (non-Pokemon) cannot be turned; the attempt is refused and costs no PP.
